about: Incorporated in November 2019, JPL is the parent entity of RJIL. RIL holds 66.43% stake in JPL. The company has created an ecosystem, comprising networks, devices, applications and content to provide seamless services. Along with RJIL, JPL has investments in digital technology, including artificial intelligence, online education and digital media and content [1]
